description: This file defines an interface for a stateless worker stream consumer grain in Orleans, specifying a method to become a consumer for a stream by providing a stream ID and provider name.

classes.name: IStatelessWorkerStreamConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for a stateless worker stream consumer that extends IGrainWithIntegerKey.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Sets up the grain to become a consumer for a specified stream identified by streamId, using the specified provider.
